scriptLines: idadmisiones derive(admission_date = iif(   isNull(discharge_date) || trim(discharge_date) == '' || upper(trim(discharge_date)) == 'NULL',   toDate(null()),   iif(     year(       coalesce(         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MM-yyyy'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy')       )     ) < 1900,     toDate(null()),     coalesce(       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MM-yyyy'),       toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy')     )   ) ),

discharge_date = iif(   isNull(discharge_date) || trim(discharge_date) == '' || upper(trim(discharge_date)) == 'NULL',   toDate(null()),   iif(     year(       coalesce(         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MM-yyyy'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy')       )     ) < 1900,     toDate(null()),     coalesce(       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MM-yyyy'),       toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy')     )   ) )) ~> fechasadmisiones

fechasadmisiones derive(department = case(   startsWith(lower(trim(department)), 'onco'), 'Oncology',   startsWith(lower(trim(department)), 'cardio'), 'Cardiology',   lower(trim(department)) == 'er' || startsWith(lower(trim(department)), 'emerg'), 'Emergency',   startsWith(lower(trim(department)), 'ped') || startsWith(lower(trim(department)), 'paed'), 'Pediatrics',   startsWith(lower(trim(department)), 'gen') || lower(trim(department)) == 'general surgery', 'General Surgery',   startsWith(lower(trim(department)), 'neur'), 'Neurology',   startsWith(lower(trim(department)), 'ortho'), 'Orthopedics',   initCap(trim(department)) )) ~> departamento

idsdiagnosticos derive(icd_code = iif(   isNull(icd_code) || trim(icd_code) == '' || upper(trim(icd_code)) == 'NULL',   toString(null()),   regexReplace(     upper(       regexReplace(         replace(trim(icd_code), '-', '.'),         '\\s*,\\s*',         ', '       )     ),     '\\b([A-Z]\\d{2})(\\d+)',     '$1.$2'   ) ),

diagnosis_description = iif(   isNull(diagnosis_description) || trim(diagnosis_description) == '' || upper(trim(diagnosis_description)) == 'NULL',   toString(null()),   initCap(trim(diagnosis_description)) )) ~> codigodescripcion

codigodescripcion derive(severity = iif(   isNull(severity) || trim(severity) == '' || upper(trim(severity)) == 'NULL',   toString(null()),   case(     lower(trim(severity)) == 'mild', 'Mild',     lower(trim(severity)) == 'moderate', 'Moderate',     lower(trim(severity)) == 'severe', 'Severe',     lower(trim(severity)) == 'critical', 'Critical',     initCap(trim(severity))   ) )) ~> severidad

date_of_birth = iif(   isNull(date_of_birth) || trim(date_of_birth) == '' || upper(trim(date_of_birth)) == 'NULL',   toDate(null()),   iif(     year(       coalesce(         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MM-yyyy'),         toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM-dd-yy')       )     ) < 1900,     toDate(null()),     coalesce(       toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),       toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),       toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),       toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),       toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MM-yyyy'),       toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM-dd-yy')     )   ) )) ~> idfechas
phone = iif(   isNull(phone) || trim(phone) == '' || upper(trim(phone)) == 'NULL' || lower(trim(phone)) == 'unknown',   toString(null()),   right(regexReplace(trim(phone), '[^0-9]', ''), 10) ),

email = iif(   isNull(email) || trim(email) == '' || upper(trim(email)) == 'NULL',   toString(null()),   lower(replace(replace(replace(trim(email), ' at ', '@'), ',com', '.com'), 'gmial.com', 'gmail.com')) ),
address = iif(   isNull(address) || trim(address) == '' || upper(trim(address)) == 'NULL',   toString(null()),   trim(replace(replace(address, 'Ã‚', ''), 'Â', '')) )) ~> contactotexto

contactotexto derive(gender = case(   lower(trim(gender)) == 'm' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'male', 'Male',   lower(trim(gender)) == 'f' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'female', 'Female',   toString(null()) ),

insurance_provider = iif(   isNull(insurance_provider) || trim(insurance_provider) == '' || upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'NULL',   toString(null()),   case(     startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'cigna'), 'Cigna',     startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'aetna'), 'Aetna',     startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'blue'), 'BlueCross',     startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'medicaid'), 'Medicaid',     startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'medi'), 'Medicare',     lower(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'uhc' || startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'united'), 'UnitedHealth',     startsWith(lower(trim(insurance_provider)), 'self'), 'Self-Pay',     initCap(trim(insurance_provider))   ) )) ~> catalogos
idsmonto derive(charge_type = iif(   isNull(charge_type) || trim(charge_type) == '' || upper(trim(charge_type)) == 'NULL',   toString(null()),   initCap(trim(charge_type)) ),

payment_status = iif(   isNull(payment_status) || trim(payment_status) == '' || upper(trim(payment_status)) == 'NULL',   toString(null()),   case(     lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'paid', 'Paid',     lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'pending', 'Pending',     lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'unpaid', 'Unpaid',     lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'overdue', 'Overdue',     initCap(trim(payment_status))   ) )) ~> cargoestado

cargoestado derive(payment_date = iif(   isNull(payment_date) || trim(payment_date) == '' || upper(trim(payment_date)) == 'NULL',   toDate(null()),   iif(     year(       coalesce(         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'dd-MM-yyyy'),         toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM-dd-yy')       )     ) < 1900,     toDate(null()),     coalesce(       toDate(trim(payment_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),       toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),       toDate(trim(payment_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),       toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),       toDate(trim(payment_date), 'dd-MM-yyyy'),       toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM-dd-yy')     )   ) )) ~> fechacosto

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(department)) AS nombre_departamento
FROM silver.admissions
WHERE department IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(department)) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(charge_type)) AS tipo_cargo,
    LTRIM(RTRIM(payment_status)) AS estado_pago
FROM silver.billing
WHERE charge_type IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(charge_type)) <> ''
  AND payment_status IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(payment_status)) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(icd_code)) AS codigo_icd,
    diagnosis_description AS descripcion_patologia,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(severity)), ''), 'No especificada') AS nivel_severidad
FROM silver.diagnoses
WHERE icd_code IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(icd_code)) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    patient_id AS patient_id_bk,
    LTRIM(RTRIM(full_name)) AS nombre_completo,
    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(gender))) IN ('M', 'MALE', 'MASCULINO') THEN 'Masculino'
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(gender))) IN ('F', 'FEMALE', 'FEMENINO') THEN 'Femenino'
        ELSE 'Otro'
    END AS genero,
    date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento,
    CASE
        WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 18 THEN '0-18'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 35 THEN '19-35'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 60 THEN '36-60'
        ELSE '60+'
    END AS rango_etario,
    email AS correo_electronico,
    address AS direccion,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(insurance_provider)), ''), 'Sin seguro') AS proveedor_seguro
FROM silver.patients
WHERE patient_id IS NOT NULL
  AND full_name IS NOT NULL',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), fecha, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key,
    CAST(fecha AS DATE) AS fecha_completa,
    CAST(YEAR(fecha) AS SMALLINT) AS anio,
    CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, fecha) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre,
    CONCAT('T', DATEPART(QUARTER, fecha)) AS trimestre_nombre,
    CAST(MONTH(fecha) AS TINYINT) AS mes,
    CASE MONTH(fecha)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Enero'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Febrero'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Marzo'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Abril'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Mayo'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Junio'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Julio'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Agosto'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Septiembre'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Octubre'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Noviembre'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Diciembre'
    END AS mes_nombre,
    CASE MONTH(fecha)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Ene'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Feb'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Mar'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Abr'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Jun'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Jul'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Ago'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Sep'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Oct'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Dic'
    END AS mes_corto,
    CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, fecha) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio,
    CAST(DAY(fecha) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes,
    CAST(((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7) + 1 AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana,
    CASE ((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7) + 1
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Lunes'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Martes'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Miércoles'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Jueves'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Viernes'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Sábado'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Domingo'
    END AS dia_nombre,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7) + 1 IN (6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT discharge_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT payment_date AS fecha FROM silver.billing WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL
) AS FechasUnicas',

query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    dp.paciente_key,
    ddp.departamento_key,
    COALESCE(ddg.diagnostico_key, (SELECT TOP 1 diagnostico_key FROM gold.dim_diagnostico)) AS diagnostico_key,
    CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112) AS INT)
    END AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date)
    END AS dias_estancia,
    1 AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp
    ON dp.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento ddp
    ON ddp.nombre_departamento = LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department))
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        admission_id,
        MIN(icd_code) AS icd_code,
        MIN(COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(severity)), ''), 'No especificada')) AS severity
    FROM silver.diagnoses
    GROUP BY admission_id
) d_adm
    ON d_adm.admission_id = a.admission_id
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico ddg
    ON ddg.codigo_icd = d_adm.icd_code
   AND ddg.nivel_severidad = d_adm.severity',

query: 'SELECT
    b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk,
    b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    dp.paciente_key,
    ddp.departamento_key,
    dsc.servicio_cargo_key,
    CASE
        WHEN b.payment_date IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), b.payment_date, 112) AS INT)
    END AS fecha_pago_key,
    b.amount AS monto_facturado,
    1 AS conteo_transacciones
FROM silver.billing b
INNER JOIN silver.admissions a
    ON a.admission_id = b.admission_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp
    ON dp.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento ddp
    ON ddp.nombre_departamento = LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department))
INNER JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo dsc
    ON dsc.tipo_cargo = LTRIM(RTRIM(b.charge_type))
   AND dsc.estado_pago = LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_status))',
